Class SimulationEngine.Boarding

java.lang.Object
org.example.Model.ServicePoint
org.example.Model.SimulationEngine.Boarding
Enclosing class:
SimulationEngine
public class SimulationEngine.Boarding extends ServicePoint
Represents the boarding service point in the simulation. This service point handles the final boarding stage of the passenger journey. When boarding is completed, the passenger is marked as finished in the system.
